description: §19.16.3 rule 1 (S430 round 5, F5) — `yield` inside a deferred body is E-DEFER-CONTROL-FLOW (exactly once), not an emitted-JS error ('yield is reserved').
rationale: §19.16.3 rule 1: a deferred body SHALL NOT contain a `yield` / `yield*` — it would suspend the generator from inside a block that is already exiting.
